text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and taking action to reduce their impact. The first step is to identify risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, you can develop mitigation strategies to lower the chance of them occurring or reduce the damage they cause. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a problem actually happens. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By regularly checking your situation, you can respond quickly and keep everything under control.
